title: Bihar DCECE-PE 2026 2nd Round Allotment Result
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
vacancyDetails: Second round seat allotment for Polytechnic Engineering (PE) admissions in Bihar through DCECE 2026
qualification: 10th / Matric with eligibility as per DCECE PE 2026 prospectus + valid DCECE rank
applicationFee: Counselling / admission fees as per BCECEB schedule
selectionProcess: DCECE PE Exam → Rank → Online Counselling Choice Filling → Seat Allotment Rounds → Document Verification → Admission
documentsRequired: Allotment letter, rank card, 10th mark sheet, category certificate, photo ID, passport photos
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Second Round Seat Allotment Result of DCECE[PE]-2026
3. Login and download allotment letter
4. Check Opening & Closing Rank PDF
5. Report for document verification as per board schedule (e.g. from 27 July 2026 if notified)
shortDescription: BCECEB has released DCECE-PE 2026 2nd Round Seat Allotment Result with opening/closing ranks. Check allotment on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has published the Second Round Seat Allotment Result of DCECE [PE]-2026 (Polytechnic Engineering).

Along with allotment, the board released Opening and Closing Rank PDFs for Round 2. Candidates allotted seats must complete admission and document verification within the prescribed dates.

Official website: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
